utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all. You alright? Quick one today if we can. Also, can someone sort the heating in the portakabin with the universe, because it's freezing in there again.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, nah, it's grim. I was in there first thing and the heating in the portakabin is doing absolutely nothing.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Morning.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Morning, all.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Hiya.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Morning.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Morning team.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we get into today, just so nobody doubles up, I tested the Fire Alarm Panel yesterday and it's all fine now, so that's done.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the Atlas yesterday, so don't need to put that anywhere for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Cheers. Also, seriously, the heating in the portakabin, if it gets any colder we'll all be doing the stand-up in coats.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I've already got mine on, to be fair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right then, line walk highlights, blockers, actual jobs for today. Fiona, you wanna go first?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah so, planning-wise, just an observation really, I saw the pressure on the newer turbine dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own, so I'm not raising that as a job, just flagging it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay, yep.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And another one from nights, noticed the door switch on two was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Again, not a task, just worth knowing.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Could've just been load then.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Maybe, yeah. Then blockers, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the pump in the pit, so I'm stuck on that one till they come back.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Mm, still waiting then.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah. And same story, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the barrel on three, so that's blocked as well, nothing new for the floor today, just waiting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine. Keep chasing but yeah, that's not a fresh task for this group.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Process side's mostly alright. Dryer trend was a bit noisy overnight but not horrendous.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: On that, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the desiccant unit tomorrow. Normal priority, nothing dramatic, but it wants doing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, good. Pri, you've got recalibrate the sensors on the desiccant unit tomorrow, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: While we're on bits to fetch, I'll go to the substation to pick up the replacement parts for the line 2 guard by 11am, top priority please, otherwise we lose half the morning waiting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Perfect. Mide's going to the substation to pick up the replacement parts for the line 2 guard by 11am, top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And from me, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the turbine two water valve. It's urgent, but realistically Monday to get to the bottom of it properly.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Davey will investigate the pressure drop on the turbine two water valve, Monday, it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Was that the one that dipped on trend?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: No, different thing. Similar symptom, different bit of kit.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, mine was the newer turbine only for a few minutes. This sounds separate.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, keep them separate then.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I've also got compliance stuff anyway, so I'll run the monthly fire alarm test today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, cheers Pri. Just to be clear, separate from what I did yesterday on the panel.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, different thing. Yesterday's panel check is done. I'll run the monthly fire alarm test.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Good shout.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, one for you if you've got a spare minute: can you order spare parts for the power pack on one by Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, alright, I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice. Tomasz to order spare parts for the power pack on one by Thursday, if you've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll get it raised.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Do we know exactly what's needed on the line 2 guard pack, sorry?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: For yours, Mide?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: It's the replacement parts list from stores, I sent it late yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Ah right, got it. I'll pick those up from the substation by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Top priority please, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Top priority please, understood.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: If you want, once I'm over by utilities I can have a quick look at the valve history as well before Monday, but the proper investigate the pressure drop on the turbine two water valve bit is still for Monday because it's urgent and I want the data together.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's fine, as long as we're agreed the task is with you for Monday.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, absolutely.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Any production impact from the desiccant unit sensors, Pri?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Not really. That's why I said normal priority. I'll recalibrate the sensors on the desiccant unit tomorrow and just tidy the readings up.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, fair.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: For planning, if Tomasz orders spare parts for the power pack on one by Thursday, if you've got a spare minute, copy me in and I'll make sure it's linked to the shutdown list.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah no problem, I'll copy you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything else that is actually for today, not things already done or blocked?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nope. Just to repeat, the Atlas filter is already swapped, done yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And my supplier bits are still blocked, so nothing I can hand over from those.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Same here really.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'll probably do the monthly fire alarm test after first break, if that helps people with noise and all that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Works for me.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Can you just ping us before you set it off? Last month half the lads nearly hit the roof.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll message before I run the monthly fire alarm test.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good plan.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And if anyone's near turbine two before me, just don't tweak anything on that water valve, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No worries.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything from maintenance bench?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nothing major. Just the usual backlog bits. The only specific one is the spare parts order, which I'll do.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Spot on.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I'll head off straight after this then. Need to get to the substation early doors if I'm doing the replacement parts for the line 2 guard by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, crack on.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I can update the board to show that one as top priority please, so nobody sends you somewhere else.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Are we expecting the portakabin to thaw out by lunch or nah?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Only if Sarah glares at it hard enough.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Honestly, at this point I might. But no, that's not becoming a job off this meeting either.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Shame, would've been a nice easy win.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, recap then. Pri's got recalibrate the sensors on the desiccant unit tomorrow, normal priority, and Pri will run the monthly fire alarm test. Mide will go to the substation to pick up the replacement parts for the line 2 guard by 11am, top priority please. Davey will investigate the pressure drop on the turbine two water valve, Monday, it's urgent. Tomasz will order spare parts for the power pack on one by Thursday, if you've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: All good.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Let's get on with it.
